title: RVLRY: choose the round and team tracker
summary: Four interactive alternatives, plus the 0.26.1 control and word-list refinements.
body:
Open **JNAS → Media → DropBox → RVLRY-progression-options.html** for four synchronized phone mockups. Use Previous/Next to move through teams and rounds, and Handoff/Recap to compare stages. The actual tracker structure has not changed in the APK; these are choices for review.

| Option | What it communicates | Trade-off |
|---|---|---|
| A — Header + teams | Round number stays top right; team boxes show current-round order. | Cleanest and shortest; no multi-round history. |
| B — Rounds inside each team | Each team has numbered round boxes that tick when completed. | Shows progress per team; more small symbols. Boxes are indicators, not controls. |
| C — Labeled round strip | Explicit Round 1 / Round 2 / Round 3 above teams. | Most explicit but uses another row. |
| D — One compact tracker | Round and team position share one heading above a slim team line. | Compact, but moves round information out of the header. |

My preference is A for minimalism, or B if seeing each team's round history is useful. Purple/slate indicates progress; teal indicates actions.

Version **0.26.1** implements the separate requests: settings in rows, more visible word history, distinct skipped/unplayed recap rows, taller Correct at two-thirds width, and Lucide standard icons including Info. The APK is in **JNAS → Media → DropBox → RVLRY-0.26.1-prototype.apk**. Install over the existing app.

Answers are stored in Kestrel and can be fetched by this project. Submitting does not automatically start an agent.
